equipment.name: Toxin bombs
equipment.desc: Whenever an enemy unit declares a Charge against the unit, roll a die for each of its models that charged. On a 1 that model suffers a wound that only a ward save can prevent. Only for Character models.

equipment.name: Unnatural Resilience
equipment.desc: The model gains +1 Wound. Only for Centurions. Unique.

equipment.name: Death Cloud
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit inflict 4 automatic hits each activation in close combat. Strength: 2 AP: 0 D: 1; Poison(4+). Only for the Sergeant of a Legion Terminator Cataphractii Squad (Cataphractii armor).
